cases.purpose: Legitimate scoped basis remains usable, not blanket HOLD.
Known missing task mandate is not supplied by valid asset access.
Known missing asset access is not supplied by task mandate.
Current authoritative applicability can contradict retained positive reports.
Absence of an authority observation is not proof of absence of authority.
A peer labelled coordinator is not the principal service.
Approval for another decision cannot qualify this decision.
Half-open expiry: the observation is expired at exactly now.
Future observations must not qualify a present decision.
Two messages relaying one root are not two qualifying roots.
An instruction with root-looking fields remains an instruction.
Unqualified lineage cannot establish a second distinct root.
Conflicting fresh authority versions require requalification, not majority or latest-wins inference.
Qualified contradictory evidence is not drowned by two positive roots.
Correct qualification can arrive too late to finish a response.
A currently valid basis may expire before the response finishes.
Hidden-world control: view agrees with current underlying permission.
Hidden change after attestation: same view cannot reveal unseen revocation.
A negative statement about another resource does not veto this scope.
Fresh legitimate requalification with a new basis version is accepted without a deny-all shortcut.
Positive observations without qualified evidence do not close the evidence gap.
A null value from a trusted source is still unknown.
